text:
anya: Quick follow-up to the quant RFC — saw a noticeable spike in token-level factual errors on the int4 path in prod last night. attaching a tiny dump and timeline. can we sketch a short gating/playbook so ops know what to do when this resurfaces?

mike: Can you paste the sample prompt and the error pattern? was it longctx or short responses?

anya: Long context. pattern: correct start, then model drifts into hallucinated entity after ~350 tokens. here's a tiny excerpt of logs we pulled (sanitized):
```
REQUEST: /v1/generate | model: rwd-7b-int4 | seq: 512 | ctx-hash: abc123
PROMPT_SNIPPET: "...user: provide timeline of product launches..."
RESPONSE_SNIPPET: "...Launched Redwood Wave in 2018 (not true)."
SCORE: deg_score=0.72 when compared to fp16 baseline 0.95
```

sara: Deg_score gap + pattern looks like accumulated quant noise in KV cache for longctx. two tactics: (1) short-term circuit: route requests with seq>300 to int8/fp8 variant, (2) offline: rerun calibration on failing prompt slices and bump profile if regression persistent.

tomas: Routing per-request by seq length is cheap. per-request sampling to spot-check quality (~1% of traffic) is also useful. but beware latency bump if we do live re-calibration.

jeff: We should add a runtime flag + quick API toggle for emergency mitigation. proposal: `precision_override` param at route-level that allows values [auto,int4,int8,fp8,fp16]. default auto. example config for a rollout rule: 
```json
{"route": "/v1/generate", "precision_override": "int8", "condition": "seq>300 && deg_score_gap>0.15"}
```
This lets us flip without redeploying models.

sara: love the toggle. also add a short-circuit boolean: `halt_int4_on_degradation:true` so the runtime can auto-divert on an observed anomaly window (e.g., 5m of elevated deg_score).

rachel: From observability angle: we need a dedicated dashboard tile showing deg_score distribution by precision lane + alerting on persistent median shifts. add a small log sample sink for human debugging (sanitized). also track per-customer quality delta to avoid noisy team-level thresholds.

mike: ops questions: who runs the canary? what's the oncall flow? can we make a minimal playbook so L2 knows whether to flip route or to escalate to ML?

anya: Draft playbook idea: 1) Triage: confirm deg_score gap > 0.12 over 10k tokens and >2% failure rate. 2) Immediate mitigation: flip `precision_override` to int8 for affected route/tenant. 3) Short-circuit: enable `halt_int4_on_degradation` for 10m. 4) Collect failing prompts -> create a calibration job & schedule. 5) If calibration fixes < 48h, escalate to ML team for profile change.

tomas: Add a lightweight sampling job snippet: `curl -H "x-route: /v1/generate" /internal/sampler?rate=0.01`. sampler should compute deg_score against fp16 baseline and post anomalies to infra.

jeff: Note on API design: `precision_override` must be per-tenant and per-route, and exposed via Console + infra API. also add a readonly `effective_precision` in the response headers so SDKs can surface when fallback happened. header: `x-effective-precision: int8`

rachel: Alerts: create two tiers — P1 when customer-facing degradation (rolling 5m failure rate >5%), P2 for subtle median shifts (1h median gap >0.08). Hook P1 to paging, P2 to slack channel.

deploy-bot: deploy status: rolled canary precision-toggle v0.3 to staging at 2026-03-20T08:40Z :white_check_mark:

anya: TL;DR: everyone ok with the playbook draft? volunteers to own the runbook pages + dashboards?

sara: I'll own the short-circuit runtime bits and the calibration job template.

mike: I'll own the oncall checklist and escalation flow.

tomas: I'll add the sampler endpoint and the sampling harness.

jeff: I'll wire the Console toggle + API contract + response header change.

rachel: I'll create dashboards and the two alerting rules.

anya: Awesome — I'll write the first-pass runbook and tag each of you for review. leaving a note to pick conservative thresholds; we can iterate once we have more data. :thumbsup:
